Components of the static pages

Cut out of the live pages, with their own CSS: this is the markup the Hugo templates have to produce. Header, footer, buttons, links, tags and fields (React-rendered, the same markup the static pages carry) are on states.html. Also: The Connect form (its own page: the expert page’s CSS restyles tags).

  • Breadcrumbs
  • Cards
  • Search, tag filters, results, pagination

Breadcrumbs

Every page but Home. The last item is the current page, not a link. A long last item is cut with an ellipsis.

Cards

One card per type. Each is one stretched link; hover and focus are the real pseudo-classes (move the pointer, press Tab).

Search, tag filters, results, pagination

The Scientists list: search block with the popular tags, the empty state, the loader and the pagination. Counts and the loader are shown by script on the live pages; here they are always visible.
